entries.description: Local MCP tools for Python risk scans, protected builds, delivery inspection and traceback restoration. No source uploads or telemetry; dependency lookup is opt-in and Pro licence verification may use the network. Trial tool returns guidance only. Companion Community pre-commit hooks for mapping/private-key checks and built-output inspection are available since Core 0.13.0, via the CLI rather than MCP. Since Core 0.14.0: CI environment-key builds require issuer-signed, request-bound admission with no unsigned fallback. The license server serves the signed endpoint; older clients keep using the legacy endpoint. Workstation and offline use are unchanged. Signed endpoint denials disable caching and hide internal inactive-state values.
